DesignStatus.EndpointImplementationDesignReadyReason: All design sections defined: CLI endpoint shape, required args, authorization contract integration, synthetic rejection, idempotency check, sink wiring plan, sink restore plan, BuildDetailedAsync call plan, rollback/cleanup plan, and no-runtime-influence invariant. Design is complete and reviewable.
DesignStatus.EndpointImplementationAllowedReason: Design phase only. Actual implementation requires a separate phase. The design must be reviewed and approved before any code is written.
DesignStatus.EndpointImplementedReason: Design phase only. No implementation code exists beyond the V16.11 skeleton.

RequiredArgs.Description: Explicit confirmation that production trace execution is intended.
Hard authorization token. Must be validated before execution proceeds.
Real production workspace ID. Synthetic IDs rejected.
Real production collection ID. Synthetic IDs rejected.

CliEndpointShape.BehaviorWhenUnauthorized: Return LiveCaptureBlocked=true. Output blocked reason. No trace captured.

AuthorizationContractIntegration.IntegrationPlan: Before any execution, validate all 7 authorization factors per V16.14 contract. If any factor missing or invalid, block execution with specific reason.

FactorsCheck.Check: Non-empty string present AND not synthetic.
Non-empty string present AND not synthetic.
Workspace and collection IDs not in synthetic patterns list.
LiveCaptureExecutionImplemented must be false at design phase.

SyntheticRejection.RejectionPlan: Before creating FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink, check workspaceId and collectionId against synthetic patterns. If either matches, block execution with SyntheticWorkspaceOrCollection.

RunIdIdempotency.CheckPlan: Before creating FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink, check if output file learning/v16_15/native-production-trace-{runId}.jsonl already exists. If yes, abort with RejectExistingRunId error.

FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSinkWiringPlan.Step4: Set RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current to the file sink.

RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessorRestore.OnSuccess: Call sink.FlushAsync(). Dispose sink. Set RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current back to NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink. Clear CurrentOperationId and CurrentRequestId.
RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessorRestore.OnFailure: Call sink.FlushAsync(). Dispose sink. Set RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current back to NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink. Delete partial trace file. Log error with runId and exception.
RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessorRestore.Invariant: RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current MUST always be restored to NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink after execution, regardless of success or failure.

BuildDetailedAsyncCallPlan.WhenAuthorized: After sink is wired and all authorization checks pass, execute BasicContextPackageBuilder.BuildDetailedAsync() against the specified workspace/collection with token budget = 10000.
BuildDetailedAsyncCallPlan.WhenNotAuthorized: Return LiveCaptureBlocked=true. Do NOT call BuildDetailedAsync.
BuildDetailedAsyncCallPlan.SafetyGate: Before calling BuildDetailedAsync, verify RuntimeInfluenceAllowed=false, NeuralBiasActive=false, PackageOutputChanged=false, VectorBindingChanged=false. These are structural invariants, not runtime checks — they must always be false regardless of authorization.

RollbackCleanupPlan.Step4: On failure/abort: delete partial .jsonl trace file.
RollbackCleanupPlan.Step6: Log completion status with runId, row count, operationId, timestamp.

NoRuntimeInfluenceInvariant.Note: These invariants are structural and permanent. No endpoint implementation may modify them. The invariant check is a precondition, not a runtime decision.
